items.title: Vertiv Sees Energy Use, Efficiency Loom Large as Data Center Industry Turns to 2023
items.summary: Data centers will experience increased regulation and third-party oversight in 2023 as the world continues to grapple with the industry’s rising energy and water consumption against the backdrop of ongoing climate change. The intensified focus on the overall environmental and community impact of the data center is one of five industry trends for 2023 identified by the global data center experts at Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global provider of critical digital infrastructure and continuity solutions.

items.title: Vertiv Announces Dynamic Online Mode and New, Smaller Modules of High Power Density UPS Family
items.summary: Vertiv introduced Dynamic Online mode to the Liebert EXL S1 to meet the needs of cloud, colocation and enterprise data centers that cannot sacrifice any level of availability for incremental gains in efficiency. With efficiency up to 99 percent, the Liebert EXL S1 operating in Dynamic Online mode offers substantial energy savings over legacy UPS systems that average 94 percent efficiency, and even improves on modern UPS systems that approach 97 percent.

items.title: Vertiv announces global launch of overhead prefabricated infrastructure portfolio to accelerate data center deployment

This all-in-one solution reduces complexity and accelerates deployment times of cloud and AI training applications for greenfield and retrofit colocation and hyperscale data centers.

items.title: Vertiv delivers space-saving cooling for edge applications, with new ceiling and row systems for North America
items.summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, today announced the expansion of its thermal portfolio with the introduction of the Vertiv™ CoolPhase Ceiling and Vertiv™ CoolPhase Row cooling solutions for edge applications. The ceiling-mounted precision cooling unit is designed for edge computing and small IT spaces, preserving valuable floor space while delivering dedicated cooling for IT equipment. The row-based cooling solution is engineered for high-density data center environments and edge applications, enabling efficient thermal management close to the heat source. The Vertiv CoolPhase Row is available now in North America, while the Vertiv CoolPhase Ceiling will launch in Q2 2026.

items.title: Futu 2026 Market Outlook: Flexible and Diversified Investment Strategies for a New Global Economic Normal
items.summary: Today, Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited ("Futu"), a leading tech broker in Hong Kong, held its annual investment strategy sharing session. At the event, Arnold Tam, Chief Analyst at Futu Securities, Joe Yu, Executive Director of Institutional and Private Wealth Services at Futu Securities, and Daniel Tse, Managing Director at Futu Securities, shared forward-looking insights and investment strategies across multiple market hot topics. They anticipate increased market volatility next year, alongside a shift from this year’s “single-theme strategy” toward a more “multi-polar strategy”. Investors are advised to remain flexible and diversify across asset classes and income streams to mitigate risk effectively and capture a broader range of emerging opportunities.

items.title: Vertiv develops energy-efficient cooling and power reference architecture for the NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 platform, available as SimReady assets in NVIDIA Omniverse blueprint for AI factory design and operations
items.summary: Vertiv (NYSE: VRT), a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, announced its energy-efficient 142kW cooling and power reference architecture for the NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 platform. In addition to fully integrated end-to-end cooling and power strategies for this next generation platform, the reference architecture unlocks a new era of infrastructure design by shifting from traditional buildouts. Vertiv solutions are available as SimReady™ 3D assets in the NVIDIA Omniverse Blueprint for AI factory design and operations. The reference architecture can be customized for bespoke data center designs to dramatically reduce planning times and reduce risk during the buildout process.
